pages.title: A Whale of a Chore
pages.text: Right-click a Hullback with an iron axe and, separately, with shears.

pages.title: A Whale of a Chore
pages.text: Discover that a giant animal has its own maintenance interactions.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Follow the Hullback’s native instructions for the tool interactions. The two clicks may occur independently; no specific collected barnacle quantity is required.

pages.title: How it works
pages.text: Find a Hullback in deep oceans and clean its gunk with an axe and shears. The friendly creature becomes indebted to its helper.
